compute_topk_accuracies: compute top-k accuracy percentages for model predictions against ground truth labels
compute_topk_errors: compute top-k error percentages for model predictions against ground truth labels
count_topks_correct: count the number of correct top-k predictions for each k value
compute_multitask_topk_accuracies: compute top-k accuracy for multi-task predictions across multiple classification heads
count_multitask_topks_correct: count correct top-k predictions across multiple tasks where each task has different class counts
